span.p:
Synchronous Replication
Write must be acknowledged by quorum (3/5)
TrueTime ensures read timestamps are safe

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Writes: 50-100ms (cross-region quorum)
Reads: 1-5ms (local replica, if timestamp safe)
Consistency: External (strongest model)
CAP: CP (minority partition blocks writes)
